nodes.label: Bootstrap and scene loading
nodes.rationale: Root singleton with DontDestroyOnLoad plus SceneContext loading Bootstrap additively lets the game start from any scene in the editor.

nodes.label: SpaceCapsule / LandingCapsule starting capsule
nodes.rationale: Capsules are prefabs placed in the world (not separate scenes) so each keeps its own interior and the outside is visible from inside.

nodes.label: PauseMenuUI
nodes.rationale: In the Unity editor the pause key is the ² key instead of Escape because Escape always frees the cursor in the editor.

nodes.label: SaveManager
nodes.rationale: Save format is versioned (SaveData.CurrentVersion 2); older saves are ignored because version 2 introduced text item ids and item renumbering.

nodes.label: SaveableObject
nodes.rationale: Three kinds of ids (scene path, deterministic env_x_z_index, runtime prefab key) so scene-placed, generated and runtime objects can all be restored or recreated.

nodes.label: PlayerMovement
nodes.rationale: Gravity along slopes is cancelled so the player stays still without input; doubled gravity gives a less floaty jump; frictionless material plus wall-normal removal lets the player slide along walls without climbing.

nodes.label: EquipmentData
nodes.rationale: Oxygen tanks have their own slots separate from the back so a jetpack and oxygen can be worn at once.

nodes.label: ItemGauge (item gauge: energy, oxygen, wear)
nodes.rationale: Items with a gauge do not stack (StackMax 1) so each slot keeps its own copy and the value follows the object.

nodes.label: ItemSlotUI (click-based slot interactions)
nodes.rationale: Double click is detected by ItemSlotUI rather than clickCount because clickCount counts clicks across the whole panel.

nodes.label: TerrainFlattening
nodes.rationale: Terrain is set 18 cm under the floor so it never pokes through and buildings do not float, blending back over 2.5 m.

nodes.label: Dome
nodes.rationale: Materials are replaced by masked copies at Awake so connector masks hide wall parts without modifying the model assets.

nodes.label: Corridor (CorridorData)
nodes.rationale: A straight corridor can only join two connectors on the line between dome centres; between domes at different heights it is sheared instead of tilted so sections stay vertical and match connector flanges.

nodes.label: Natural element models (rocks, deposits, resource items)
DayNightCycle
nodes.rationale: Night brightness is drawn from the seed raised to brightNightRarity so most nights are very dark (flashlight needed) and about one in six is bright.

nodes.label: EnergyNetworkManager (network rules 1-7)
nodes.rationale: Only distribution panels separate networks and flow is one-way; optional demand is served only from surplus so it never trips a network.
